title: Sea Chart icons
mode: built-in ImageGen; anchor used as style reference
export: Generated art exported as 1024x1024 RGBA PNGs; centered visible artwork fits within 818x818, providing at least 10% clear transparent margin. Original generated sources retained.

assets.title: Hunter's Respite anchorage
assets.role: Dedicated port anchorage tile at the top-left of the Sea Chart
assets.body:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent game sea-map icon.
Subject: Port of departure harbor anchorage symbol ("Hunter's Respite").
A simple, bold antique nautical chart symbol representing a safe harbor haven and mooring anchorage. A heavy iron anchor upright in the center, looped through a thick coiled hemp mooring line, resting alongside a compact weathered stone lighthouse tower with a tiny brass-accented beacon lantern at the peak.
Style invariants: Match the approved SIMPLE antique sea-map symbol style exactly: broad slightly irregular iron-gall ink outlines #1B1612, cream #F4ECD8 and weathered tan #D5C4A1 large flat forms, sparse interior contour marks, and tiny brass #C59B27 accents on the lantern/shackle. Bold silhouette readable at 36x36 to 64x64 game icon size. No added fine texture, dense cross-hatching, photorealism, 3D render, glow, drop shadows, borders, text, or scenery. Canvas: 1024x1024 square, TRUE alpha transparency (no background paper or checkerboard baked in), with at least 10% clear transparent margins on all sides.

assets.title: Defeated monster
assets.role: Cleared sector where a sea monster was slain
assets.body:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent game sea-map icon.
Subject: Defeated sea monster cartographic skull and crossbones symbol.
A stylized, antique maritime beast skull: a weathered leviathan skull with subtle aquatic fangs and two crossed harpoons underneath. The skull features hollow iron-gall eye sockets, a cracked bone crest, and subtle cartographic crimson accents suggesting a vanquished monster on an old explorer's map.
Style invariants: Match the approved SIMPLE antique sea-map symbol style exactly: broad slightly irregular iron-gall outlines #1B1612, antique bone cream #F4ECD8 and tan #D5C4A1 flat fills, sparse linework, and selective cartographic crimson #8C2D19 ink accents along the cracks or harpoon bindings. Must read clearly as a "slain monster / danger cleared" marker at small thumbnail size (32x32 to 48x48). No 3D CGI, photorealism, modern poison/hazard symbols, neon glow, text, or frames. Canvas: 1024x1024 square, TRUE alpha transparency (no background paper or checkerboard baked in), with at least 10% clear margin on all sides.

assets.title: Uncharted fog
assets.body:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent game sea-map icon.
Subject: Uncharted maritime fog and coastal sea mist cartographic symbol.
A compact, stylized antique map illustration of swirling sea mist: three low curling nautical wave-crest scrolls interlocked with stylized wisps of rolling maritime sea fog, reminiscent of old cartographic engravings for "Terra Incognita" or shrouded waters.
Style invariants: Match the approved SIMPLE antique sea-map symbol style: broad slightly irregular iron-gall outlines #1B1612, muted cream #F4ECD8 / faint parchment tan fills, very sparse curved strokes indicating mist currents. Simple, iconic, and uncluttered so it can be repeated across locked map grid cells without visual noise. No photorealistic smoke, gradients, particle effects, glow, text, or frame. Canvas: 1024x1024 square, TRUE alpha transparency (no background paper or checkerboard baked in), with at least 10% clear margin on all sides.
